answer.headline: Senior data scientist with seven years in e-commerce and consulting, focused on sales prediction in production, split testing and large-scale data processing

experiences.title: Senior Data Scientist
experiences.summary: Builds nightly production time series prediction models for weekly sales of 9,000 styles at an online fashion retailer, runs split tests of checkout and pricing changes, moved feature jobs to Apache Spark, and wrote the SQL of the merchandising data mart. Presents results to buyers monthly.

evidence.quote: Senior Data Scientist, Lyngby Mode ApS (online fashion retailer)
Built time series prediction models for weekly sales of 9,000 styles that run in production every night.
Ran split testing for checkout and pricing changes on 1.2 million monthly visitors, including sequential testing so tests can stop early.
Moved our feature jobs from pandas to Apache Spark, cutting the nightly run from five hours to forty minutes.
Wrote the SQL behind the merchandising data mart, about 40 tables.
Communicating with stakeholders is a big part of the job: I present results to the buyers every month.
